PrerenderedAudio.title: PrerenderedAudio
PrerenderedAudio.description: Metadata and playback synchronization manifest for a pre-rendered public-domain fable or children's tale WAV recording.

cacheKey.description: Deterministic cache key identifying the story, reading mode, and voice cast.

chapterId.description: Identifier of the fable or fairy tale chapter.

bookId.description: Identifier of the collection (e.g. fabulas-esopo, contos-grimm-perrault).

chapterTitle.description: Display title of the fable or tale.

mode.description: Voice acting mode used for synthesis.

voiceMap.description: Map of character speaker names to Gemini prebuilt voice names.

durationSec.description: Total duration of the rendered WAV audio in seconds.

fileSizeBytes.description: Total byte size of the WAV audio payload.

storageType.description: Whether the binary WAV is stored in Firestore chunks or served from static CDN.

chunkCount.description: Number of binary base64 chunks stored under the chunks subcollection (0 for static-only records, 1..60 for chunked records).

staticAudioUrl.description: Optional static CDN path for bundled pre-rendered WAV assets.

segments.description: Synchronized turn-by-turn timing segments for live text highlighting (1 to 60 items).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the pre-rendered audio record.

isPublic.description: Whether this pre-rendered public-domain story is readable by all visitors.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who persisted this pre-rendered recording.

createdByName.description: Short display label of the contributor (no email or PII).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

AudioChunk.title: AudioChunk
AudioChunk.description: Single base64-encoded binary slice of a pre-rendered WAV file stored safely below Firestore's 1MB document limit.

parentCacheKey.description: Cache key of the parent PrerenderedAudio document.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary audio bytes for this chunk.

byteLength.description: Original raw byte length of this chunk before base64 encoding.

isPublic.description: Mirrors parent visibility for secure list queries without parent get() lookups.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the parent document creator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was stored.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator directory record for curator privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/prerenderedAudios/{cacheKey}.description: Catalog of every pre-rendered fable and children's tale WAV audio with voice cast and turn-by-turn timing segments.

/prerenderedAudios/{cacheKey}/chunks/{ch.description: Binary WAV chunks belonging to a pre-rendered audio catalog document.
